get.summary: Get GPS track points by bounding box
get.description: Returns GPS track points within the bounding box as GPX 1.0. Returns 5000 points per page. Increment the page parameter to retrieve subsequent pages.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box as left,bottom,right,top. Max width and height is 0.25 degrees.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (0-indexed). Each page contains up to 5000 points.
